title: Sensex jumps 990 points as autos and banks lead rebound; rupee gains for fourth day to 93.36
dek: The Nifty closed at 25,514.30 and the Nifty Bank index touched a record intraday high; IT shares fell on expectations of higher US interest rates.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
The Sensex rose 989.94 points, or 1.21 per cent, to close at 83,021.75 on Thursday, and the Nifty gained 286.35 points, or 1.14 per cent, to end at 25,514.30, recovering all of Wednesday's fall as auto and bank shares led a broad rally, according to reports.

Maruti Suzuki, Eicher Motors and Mahindra & Mahindra were among the biggest Nifty gainers; the Nifty Auto index was up 3.3 per cent by the morning. Bank shares also rose, and the Nifty Bank index touched a record intraday high of about 63,053 before closing with solid gains, reports said. Information technology shares were the main exception: the Nifty IT index fell 1.11 per cent, which analysts linked to expectations of higher US interest rates.

Market analysts cited steady buying by foreign institutional investors and easing commodity prices, including crude oil, for the rally, which came despite weak cues from other Asian markets, according to reports. Brent crude was trading at about $92 a barrel on Thursday after falling on Wednesday on expectations of a supply surplus.

The rupee rose 5 paise to close at 93.36 against the US dollar, its fourth straight gain, trading between 93.17 and 93.55 during the day, according to one report.
